records.label: Quiet window close portrait
records.image_promise: A close character portrait with calm lateral window illumination, clear facial performance, and a restrained interior background supporting the silhouette.

staging.body_geometry: Head and upper torso form one stable portrait mass with a relaxed shoulder line and readable neck connection.
staging.action_geometry: The pose remains still enough for subtle acting, with small orientation changes carrying the scene relationship.
staging.gaze_and_expression: Gaze and expression follow the requested target, emotion, and temporal moment for this particular scene.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: Any visible object contact uses clear overlap, pressure, scale, and hand or paw placement.
staging.focal_hierarchy: Eyes and identity-bearing facial structure lead, followed by silhouette, gesture, and a single environmental cue.
staging.depth_order: A simple foreground edge, character plane, and quiet room background establish compact depth.

defaults.subject: one character adapted to the requested identity and subject domain
defaults.body: identity-accurate proportions with a relaxed upper-body presentation
defaults.lighting: cool lateral window light with quiet room fill
defaults.constraints: identity anchors and requested relationships remain explicit

must_preserve: face remains the primary focal region
identity traits remain independent of transient presentation
failure_modes: scene state copied into permanent identity

records.label: Low-angle presence portrait
records.image_promise: A grounded three-quarter character portrait using a modest low viewpoint, coherent body scale, and controlled dusk separation to emphasize physical presence.

staging.body_geometry: The near shoulder, torso, and head rise through the frame as connected masses with a stable center of gravity.
staging.action_geometry: A restrained turn or stance creates depth while preserving the identity-bearing head and body proportions.
staging.gaze_and_expression: Attention follows the requested relationship, carried through head turn, eyes, facial channels, and posture together.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: Visible support or held objects connect through clear joint alignment, overlap, and believable contact pressure.
staging.focal_hierarchy: The face leads, broad body masses establish scale, and dusk edge light separates the outer contour.
staging.depth_order: A near body plane, readable face, and subdued distant field create controlled perspective depth.

defaults.subject: one character adapted to the requested identity and subject domain
defaults.body: requested proportions and build expressed through connected volumes
defaults.lighting: soft dusk rim with broad fill
defaults.constraints: facial identity and body scale remain coherent

failure_modes: tiny head caused by body scaling

records.label: Profile portrait with breathing room
records.image_promise: A reserved profile portrait with open space along the attention direction, quiet environmental context, and gentle ambient modeling across the character.

staging.body_geometry: The head contour and shoulder line create an off-center mass anchored comfortably inside the frame.
staging.action_geometry: A small head or torso turn directs attention into the open image field and supports a reflective moment.
staging.gaze_and_expression: The visible eye, mouth or muzzle, ear or sensory orientation, and posture share one selected emotional phase.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: Any object or environmental contact supports the directional pose through clear placement and scale.
staging.focal_hierarchy: Facial contour and visible eye lead, followed by directional space and one quiet context accent.
staging.depth_order: Character edge, open atmospheric field, and a restrained distant cue form shallow editorial depth.

defaults.subject: one character adapted to the requested identity and subject domain
defaults.composition: off-center portrait with gaze-directed open space
defaults.constraints: profile landmarks and attention direction remain readable

must_preserve: environment remains subordinate to the character
failure_modes: attention aimed into the nearest edge

records.label: Layered environmental character view
records.image_promise: A medium character portrait where a simple foreground cue and readable background establish place while the subject remains the dominant narrative layer.

staging.body_geometry: The visible upper or mid body forms a clear central action mass with readable posture and silhouette.
staging.action_geometry: A simple activity or environmental interaction gives the figure a purpose and organizes nearby objects around it.
staging.gaze_and_expression: The character's attention connects to the viewer, another subject, an object, or the setting according to the brief.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: Foreground and interacted objects use clear depth, overlap, contact, and scale relative to the body.
staging.focal_hierarchy: Face and action lead, the immediate context follows, and distant setting shapes provide quiet orientation.
staging.depth_order: One foreground cue, the character plane, and a simplified background establish three distinct depth layers.

defaults.body: readable requested proportions at medium portrait scale
defaults.expression: attention appropriate to the activity or relationship
defaults.environment: adaptable place with one foreground and one background cue
defaults.constraints: setting detail supports the character hierarchy
